metadata.name: Reactor
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A cooling plant on the edge of a container yard, built in the spirit of the classic reactor-plant bomb map. Embers push in from the yard; Tide hold the control room between the two sites. Upstairs is the two-storey reactor hall with its gallery; downstairs, the coolant basement, reached by the ramp room, a long secret tunnel or the control stairwell. Climb onto the roof for the railgun and a hatch down into the plant.
